# Code of Conduct

## Scope

This policy applies to repository issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, and other project-managed communication spaces.

## Expected behavior

Participants must:

- communicate precisely, respectfully, and in good faith;
- distinguish verified evidence from assumptions;
- review security-sensitive changes without personal attacks;
- protect private data, credentials, vulnerability details, and affected users;
- accept correction and revise claims when evidence changes.

## Unacceptable behavior

The following are not accepted:

- harassment, discrimination, threats, or targeted intimidation;
- publishing private information or live credentials;
- reckless or coercive vulnerability disclosure;
- deliberately misleading technical claims;
- sustained disruption of reviews, issues, or incident response;
- retaliation against a person who reports a security or conduct concern.

## Reporting

Report conduct concerns privately to the repository owner through a verified private channel. Do not place sensitive evidence in a public issue.

A report should include the relevant links, dates, participants, and a factual description. Avoid speculation and unnecessary personal data.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit or remove content, restrict participation, close discussions, or block accounts when necessary to protect contributors, users, or the security process. Enforcement decisions should be proportional, documented, and based on available evidence.
